newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - AT&T falls on profit warning.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - AT&T falls on profit warning.

text.p: Shares in AT&T Corp fell 3-1/4 to 54 preceding Tuesday's U.S. market open on selling traders attributed to AT&T's warning that third quarter profits are expected to come in as much as 10 percent below analysts' estimates.
In later pre-open trade, the shares continued to fall, hitting 53-1/2.
"ATT warned their quarter is going to be about 10 percent lower than expectations, and that is an easy 10 points off the Dow (Jones Industrial average) right there," a trader said.
